sn56.129-130:1.1: eva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye pittivisayā cutā devesu paccājāyanti || atha kho ete va bahutarā sattā ye pittivisayā cutā niraye paccājāyanti || || Evam eva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye pittivisayā cutā devesu paccājāyanti || atha kho ete va bahutarā sattā ye pittivisayā cutā tiracchānayoniyā paccājāyanti || || Evam
